record.exceptions: Ukrainian exit processing remained normal at initial notice; prior passenger exceptions cannot be assumed at every approach-road moment.

record.uncertainty: Romanian road and Ukrainian checkpoint accounts describe different scopes; exact onset and resumption clock times unknown.
